title: Prompt Code card type or flow code matches expected context
Account Number representation agrees with POS entry method
Account Number or identification value is present for the transaction context
Grand Total, Card Label, Card Type Total Count, and Card Type Total Amount are required

Field order matches Section 12.7 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Loyalty Program ID, Loyalty Account Number, Points to Redeem, Coupon ID, Coupon Amount, Update Code, Street Address, Phone Number Loyalty, Expiration Date, Payment Tender Type, Loyalty Track 2 Data, Loyalty Information Version, Unit of Work)
Loyalty Account Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 24

MICR Data (Element 122) is cross-referenced from Account Number (Element 2) of the Standard Message Data Segment (100); the extract states MICR data 'is also included' there but does not state a byte-identity or co-validation rule between the two representations

Prompt Code (Element 78) is Required, field 6, 3 digits, and must be one of the five documented values: 901 (Custom receipt text), 902 (Dynamic card table), 903 (Site configuration data), 904 (Host discount data), 905 (Fuel volume data), per Appendix E's Valid Card Type Codes Used in Special Transaction Prompt Codes

When Prompt Code is 904 (Host Discount Data, response only), fields 14-27 are: Host Discount Timestamp (179, 12), Number of Discounts (171, 2), then a repeated block of Start Date (165,8), Start Time (166,4), End Date (165,8), End Time (166,4), BUYPASS Card Type (173,4), Card BIN Range Beginning (183,12), Card BIN Range Ending (184,12), Product Code (77,3), Product Discount Amount (172,5), Product Code (77,3), Discount Quantity Limit (185,3), Discount Program Description (186,15), for a total variable length not to exceed 3,600 bytes
Card Label is required for each card bucket
Card Type Total Count is required for each card bucket
Card Type Total Amount is required for each card bucket
Approved responses include card types 1 through 15
Card types 16 through 20 are included only when data occurs
Token PAN Suffix (Element 197, 4 chars, Conditional, Issuer/Authorizer-sourced) — the last 4 digits of the cardholder PAN — is returned in the response only if supplied by the authorizer

Network Token Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as 6 fixed sub-tables: 001 (Network Token, 013-018 bytes), 002 (Expiration Date, fixed 004), 003 (Provisional Fee Indicator, fixed 001), 004 (Input Indicator, fixed 001), 005 (Eligible Indicator, fixed 001), 006 (PAN Indicator, fixed 001)
Card Status (Table 004) valid values: A (New Acct# & Exp Date), E (New Exp Date), Q (Contact Cardholder), C (Closed), U (Unknown Card)
Segment 156 is sent only for an EV charging transaction (EV fuel code in Segment 102 Product Code Segment), and is applicable to the Visa card type only
Number of Card Types (Element 59) identifies how many times field 8 (Card Type) repeats — Card Type may repeat 01-99 times
A Card Type value of '173' in this segment's repeating Card Type field (Element 14) conditionally triggers Segment DL6 (Store and Forward) in the same Table Load Response

Each repeated Card Type (Element 14) must be a valid Appendix E 'Card Type Code Used in the Table Load Response': an accepted card type or a device feature code (for example 127, 148, 150, 162-168, 171, 173, 174); feature codes are never used in Prompt Codes

Table Load Response block order is ')' + DL1, then DL2 (Conditional), then DL3 (Conditional), then End-of-Load Indicator '*' (Element 35); when DL1 carries Card Type 173, DL6 (Data Block No. 4) follows and the load ends with '*'. For TCP/IP the Start-of-Data Block Indicator appears only before Data Block No. 1
Segment DL6 is only sent in a Table Load Response when Segment DL1 (Merchant Data Segment) includes a Card Type value of 173 in Data Element No. 14 (Card Type)

Card Type 173 'Enables Store and Forward blocking for a designated range of time each day'; the DL6 Start Time and End Time define that daily recurring window during which the device blocks store-and-forward processing

Floor Limit Data repeats per RID, for a maximum of 24 RIDs, total variable length up to 624 bytes; each repetition contains RID (233,10, Host-sourced), Stand-in Indicator (234,1, Host-sourced), Floor Limit (235,12, Host-sourced, maximum allowable stand-in value), BUYPASS RID Card Type (236,3, Host-sourced)

RID (Element 233) is AN fixed 10 and must be a valid EMV Registered Application Provider identifier; Stand-in Indicator (Element 234) is N1 with values 1 (No Stand-in), 2 (Domestic only Stand-in), 3 (Domestic & Foreign Stand-in); Floor Limit (Element 235) is N fixed 12, 000000000000-999999999999; BUYPASS RID Card Type (Element 236) is AN fixed 3
